contexts.text: To suck the milk of the Gentiles, and the breast of kings () = to be endowed with goods and instructed in truths.
The breasts have become firm () = natural good.

Blessings of the breasts () = affections of good and truth... The breasts = affections of good and truth. The reason why the breasts = these affections, is that they communicate with the organs of generation, and thereby appertain to the province of marriage love... which corresponds to... the marriage of good and truth... and also because infants are nourished by means of the breasts; and through this affection they signify the conjunction of marriage love with love towards offspring.

These affections are also signified by breasts in thou shalt suck the milk of the Gentiles, and thou shalt suck the breasts of kings... To suck the breasts of kings = good from truth; for kings = truths.
The breasts have become firm () = interior affections of good and truth.
Their breasts have been pressed () = that the affections of good and truth have been perverted through falsifications.
Adulteries from between the breasts () = affections of good and truth adulterated.
Dry breasts () = no affections of good and truth.
To gird themselves upon the beating breasts () = to be in grief on account of the good of truth being lost.
Girt at the paps with a golden girdle () = the good of love.

Blessed is the womb that bare Thee, and the paps which Thou hast sucked. But Jesus said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the Word of God and keep it (). It is manifest from the Lord's answer what the blessed womb, and what the paps signify, namely, those who hear the Word of God and keep it, thus affections of truth, which are they who hear the Word of God, and affections of good, which are they who keep or do it.
To suck the milk of the Gentiles = the insinuation of celestial good; to suck the breasts of kings = the insinuation of celestial truth.
Dry breasts = no affections, but instead thereof cupidities of perverting.
Paps = the delight of the good of love, because milk comes from them.
Breasts of consolations () = Divine good... Breast = spiritual love.
Breasts = truths from the good of charity, here (dry breasts), falsities from evil contrary to them.
A mother's breasts () = spiritual nourishment in such things as are of the Church.
Blessed are the... paps which never gave suck () = those who have not genuine truths from the good of charity... Paps have a similar signification to milk, that is, truth from good.
To suck and be satisfied from the breast of her consolations = to be instructed to the full in truths from good from the delight of love, even to the desire.
